name: characcon
description:
CHARACCON is a Solana-based meme token inspired by the idea of an on-chain “Multiverse of Moods.” The project turns emotions, internet culture, and community-driven meme energy into a playful Web3 identity.

At the center of CHARACCON is a cute mood-based mascot that represents the changing sentiment of the community. The project is built around a simple concept: every holder brings a different vibe, and together those vibes form a decentralized mood universe.

CHARACCON is launched on Solana, benefiting from fast transactions, low fees, and an active meme coin ecosystem. The token is designed for community participation, social engagement, and meme-driven growth across platforms such as X and Telegram.
